anya_ml: Proposal: lightweight admission-control (sidecar) to accept/downgrade/reject fp8/int8/4bit per-request based on quality budgets, SLA, and runtime health.

mike_runtime: Is this safety-only or also a cost/backpressure mechanism?

anya_ml: Both — stop regressions, avoid low-bit tail-costs under memory/KV pressure, and enable predictable canaries.

raj_ops: Policy scope? per-model/per-customer/per-endpoint? Ops needs billing tie-ins.

anya_ml: Stack = global -> model annotations -> customer overrides. Eval order: customer SLA -> model acceptability -> runtime signals -> sampling guardrail. Return final_precision or reject.

liz_prodeng: Billing: if we downgrade, we must bill deterministically. Suggest emitting verdict proto: final_precision, reason_code, quality_risk_score, cost_estimate.

mike_runtime: Runtime contract: headers `x-precision-hint`, optional `x-quality-budget`. Sidecar returns `x-final-precision`, `x-admission-reason`, `x-admission-token`. Target <1ms. If sidecar down, runtime falls back conservatively (FP16).

anya_ml: Example policy snippet (pseudo):
policy: default { allowed: [fp16,int8], deny_on_high_load: true }
model_overrides: { 'redwood-test': { min_acceptability:0.95, allowed:[fp8,int8,fp16] } }
customer_profiles: { 'acme': { max_degradation:0.005 } }

liz_prodeng: Need realtime quality signals — shadow-sample ~1% to high-precision path and compute slice deltas. Admission uses sliding-window stats to disable low-bit when thresholds exceeded.

mike_runtime: Shadowing ok, but correlate cache-hit and prefix-length; KV effects change deltas.

raj_ops: Rollout controls: console canary toggles, per-customer force-allow/deny, emergency circuit-breaker. Admin ACLs for overrides and audited policy store.

anya_ml: Telemetry: model, endpoint, customer_id, requested_precision, final_precision, admission_token, shadow_delta_pct, cache_hit, reason_code. Surface in Console.

mike_runtime: Prototype as sidecar to iterate rules without runtime change. Sidecar handshake `/admission/verdict`. Ensure idempotence for retries by binding verdict to request-id in admission token.

anya_ml: Action items: 1) I’ll write RFC with DSL and API this week. 2) Mike to sketch sidecar shim + runtime header PR. 3) Raj to produce billing mapping + canary playbook. 4) Liz to mock dashboard and alerts.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: feature-flags/admission-sidecar canary in staging 2026-03-24T18:00:00Z :rocket:

mike_runtime: Note: keep CPU overhead low; admission mostly in-memory checks + occasional async reads from stats backend.

liz_prodeng: :thumbsup: excited to see RFC and dashboard.

mike_runtime: ack, will review RFC/PRs.
